verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own alert integrations: Slack notifications to any channel, PagerDuty incidents created from error activity, and general alerting to team communication tools. That covers the delivery-destination half of the story. The evidence never shows the routing logic or per-rule trigger thresholds that are the core of this alerting-noise story. Missing for 10: routing by project/environment/severity, email alerts, per-rule thresholds for new issue, frequency spike, and affected-user count, and independent corroboration.
